svg.title: The specialists and the person who approves
svg.desc: Specialists sit in a row at one long table: support with a headset, sales, finance, legal, HR, operations, data, design, product, marketing, the CEO advisor and small business, each with a small prop of their work in front of them. In the centre a person stands and holds up a page marked with a green check: they approve the work before it goes out.
